context: Evaluates citation discipline, confidence-tier phrasing, and honest gap-reporting when investigating a design decision.

checklist.name: direct_claims_cited
checklist.description: Every claim placed in "What We Found" carries an explicit citation.

checklist.name: inferred_claims_hedged
checklist.description: Claims in "What We Can Reasonably Infer" use hedged language and make the inference chain explicit.

checklist.name: no_code_as_self_evidence
checklist.description: No claim treats the code's own shape or value as evidence of its own intent.

checklist.name: dont_know_section_present
checklist.description: "What We Don't Know" is present and names specific unanswered questions or empty searches.

checklist.name: no_fabricated_certainty
checklist.description: No claim is stated with confident language ("because", "the reason is") when the underlying evidence is indirect.
